[10:49 p.m. MST]

Work on issue FV-W86KWZ: Add third-party notices and a list of bundled assets to the package

Found by the release pass. The project has no third-party notices file and no list of bundled assets, and the .deb ships only the binary, the .desktop file and two icons. The binary embeds third-party fonts and code whose licenses require their notices to travel with copies:

- **Fonts compiled in by libcosmic** (`src/app/mod.rs` `EMBEDDED_FONTS`, unconditional): Open Sans Light, Regular, Semibold, Bold and ExtraBold (SIL OFL 1.1, © 2020 The Open Sans Project Authors, `res/open-sans/LICENSE`), and Noto Sans Mono Regular and Bold (SIL OFL 1.1, `res/noto/LICENSE`). OFL 1.1 requires the copyright notice and license to accompany the font.
- **Iced-Icons.ttf**, embedded by `iced_graphics` (`iced/graphics/src/text.rs`): it has no license file of its own beside it; iced is MIT. Confirm its origin and license upstream. (FiraSans is behind the `fira-sans` feature, which isn't enabled here.)
- **The project's own icons** (`data/icons/*-symbolic.svg`): an agent wrote them by hand in the scaffold session (FV-19XWHQ), with no third-party source. List them as the project's own, under the project license.
- **About 527 crates in the Linux build**, mostly MIT and/or Apache-2.0, plus BSD, ISC, Zlib, Unicode-3.0, MPL-2.0, CC0 and BSL-1.0. MIT, BSD and similar licenses require their copyright notices in redistributed binaries.

Suggested approach: generate `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES` with a pinned `cargo-about` (or a similar tool), add the fonts' OFL texts, keep a short `docs/BUNDLED-ASSETS.md` (each asset, owner, license, where its notice is), and add the notices to `[package.metadata.deb] assets` under `usr/share/doc/cosmic-ext-nightlight/`. Do it after the license decision in the R33 issue, since the project license appears in the same files.

[package.metadata.deb]
name = "cosmic-ext-nightlight"
maintainer = "cosmic-ext-nightlight contributors"
section = "utils"
priority = "optional"
extended-description = "A panel applet for COSMIC that toggles night light by setting display gamma through the Wayland wlr-gamma-control protocol."
# $auto adds the shared libraries the binary actually links (libc6 and
# libxkbcommon0 today; wayland-client uses the pure-Rust backend).
# cosmic-panel hosts the applet, so it is required. cosmic-comp provides the
# gamma protocol but is only recommended, so it is not forced onto other setups.
depends = "$auto, cosmic-panel"
recommends = "cosmic-comp"
assets = [
    ["target/release/cosmic-ext-nightlight", "usr/bin/", "755"],
    ["data/io.github.cosmic_ext.Nightlight.desktop", "usr/share/applications/", "644"],
    ["data/icons/io.github.cosmic_ext.Nightlight-on-symbolic.svg", "usr/share/icons/hicolor/scalable/status/", "644"],
    ["data/icons/io.github.cosmic_ext.Nightlight-off-symbolic.svg", "usr/share/icons/hicolor/scalable/status/", "644"],
]

The README fingerprint placeholder must be replaced with the real signing-key fingerprint before the first v* tag; the build job fails while it is there.
- [k5] release.yml fails if README.md contains the fingerprint placeholder text (grep for 'FINGERPRINT-TO-BE-FILLED-IN'). Don't write that exact token anywhere else in the README, or a filled-in README would still fail.

As of 2026-11-13 no release has published the apt repository (gh-pages is empty).
- [k12] scripts/publish-apt.sh can be tested locally without a real key: make a throwaway ed25519 key in a temporary GNUPGHOME and a dummy .deb with dpkg-deb --build, then run the script on an empty site folder.

# Releasing (maintainers)

This page is for maintainers. Users: see the [README](../README.md).

## Build a .deb package locally

Install `cargo-deb` once (`cargo install --locked cargo-deb`; checked with
version 3.8.0), then:

```sh
just deb                # cargo deb --locked; builds the release binary too
sudo apt install ./target/debian/cosmic-ext-nightlight_*.deb
```

The package installs the same files as `just install` and depends on the
shared libraries the binary links (detected automatically), plus `cosmic-panel`.
It recommends `cosmic-comp`, which provides the gamma protocol the applet needs;
without it the toggle will not work. The libc6 minimum is taken from the
machine that builds the package, so build on the oldest release you want it to
install on.

## How a release is built

Publishing a GitHub release runs `.github/workflows/release.yml`. It has three
jobs, so that code from the build never shares a runner with the signing key
or a write token:

- `build` checks out the release's tag, checks the tag equals `v` plus the
  `version` in `Cargo.toml`, builds the `.deb` with `just deb` (no cache; `just`
  and `cargo-deb` at fixed versions) and hands the `.deb` and its hash on. It

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Write THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES: the license text of every crate in the Linux build.

Usage (needs the crates fetched, e.g. after `cargo fetch --locked`):
    python3 -I scripts/gen-third-party-notices.py > THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES

Reads `cargo metadata --locked` for x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu, so the output
depends only on Cargo.lock. Crates are sorted by name and version, so the
output is the same on every run. Crates with no license file in their
package get their SPDX expression and repository instead.
"""
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys

LICENSE_FILE = re.compile(r"^(LICEN[CS]E|COPYING|NOTICE|UNLICENSE)", re.I)


def main():
    out = subprocess.run(
        ["cargo", "metadata", "--locked", "--format-version", "1",
         "--filter-platform", "x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu"],
        check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    meta = json.loads(out)
    root = meta["resolve"]["root"]
    packages = sorted(meta["packages"], key=lambda p: (p["name"], p["version"]))
    print("THIRD-PARTY NOTICES for cosmic-ext-nightlight\n")
    print("cosmic-ext-nightlight itself is GPL-3.0-only (see LICENSE). It is built")
    print("from the crates below, whose license notices follow. Fonts and other")
    print("bundled assets are listed in docs/BUNDLED-ASSETS.md.\n")
    # Crates in the same package often share one license text; print each
    # distinct text once, with the crates it covers.
    texts = {}
    for p in packages:
        if p["id"] == root:
            continue
        folder = os.path.dirname(p["manifest_path"])
        found = []
        for name in sorted(os.listdir(folder)):
            path = os.path.join(folder, name)
            if LICENSE_FILE.match(name) and os.path.isfile(path):
                with open(path, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
                    found.append((name, f.read().strip()))
        header = "{} {} ({})".format(
            p["name"], p["version"], p["license"] or "license not declared")
        if p.get("repository"):
            header += " <{}>".format(p["repository"])
        if not found:
            found = [("", "No license file is shipped in this crate's package; "
                          "see the repository above.")]
        for name, text in found:
            texts.setdefault(text, []).append(header)
    for text, headers in sorted(texts.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1][0]):
        print("=" * 78)
        for h in headers:
            print(h)
        print("-" * 78)
        print(text)
        print()
    print("Crates covered: {}".format(len(packages) - 1), file=sys.stderr)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# Bundled assets and third-party notices

What the `cosmic-ext-nightlight` binary and package contain that did not
originate in this project, who owns it, its license, and where the notice is.
The package installs the notices under
`/usr/share/doc/cosmic-ext-nightlight/`.

The project itself is GPL-3.0-only (`LICENSE`, installed there as `copyright`-
adjacent file `LICENSE`).

| Asset | Owner | License | Notice |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Open Sans Light, Regular, Semibold, Bold, ExtraBold (compiled in by libcosmic, `EMBEDDED_FONTS`) | The Open Sans Project Authors, <https://github.com/googlefonts/opensans> | SIL OFL 1.1 | `fonts/OFL-OpenSans.txt` (from `res/open-sans/LICENSE` in libcosmic) |
| Noto Sans Mono Regular, Bold (compiled in by libcosmic) | The Noto Project Authors | SIL OFL 1.1 | `fonts/OFL-NotoSansMono.txt` (from `res/noto/LICENSE` in libcosmic) |
| `Iced-Icons.ttf` (compiled in by `iced_graphics` 0.14.0) | iced contributors; the font was generated with Fontello (its metadata says "Copyright (C) 2020 by original authors @ fontello.com") | Shipped inside the MIT-licensed `iced_graphics` crate; no separate license file | The `iced_graphics` MIT text in `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES`. **Open point:** the upstream license of the individual glyphs was not confirmed (no network access when this was written). Confirm with iced-rs/iced before the first release. |
| FiraSans (iced's `fira-sans` feature) | | | Not enabled in this build; not shipped. |
| `data/icons/*-symbolic.svg` | This project | GPL-3.0-only | Drawn by hand for this project; no third-party source. |
| About 510 Rust crates linked or built for the Linux target | Their authors | Mostly MIT and/or Apache-2.0, plus BSD, ISC, Zlib, Unicode-3.0, MPL-2.0, CC0, BSL-1.0 | `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES` |

Note: libcosmic's `applet` feature also links GPL-3.0 crates from
pop-os/cosmic-panel (`cosmic-panel-config`, `xdg-shell-wrapper-config`), and
libcosmic itself is MPL-2.0; both are in `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES`.

## Regenerating `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES`

The file is generated from `Cargo.lock` by `scripts/gen-third-party-notices.py`
(Python 3 standard library only; the crates must be fetched):

```sh
just notices        # cargo fetch --locked, then rewrites THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES
```

Regenerate it whenever `Cargo.lock` changes, and commit the result. Crates
that ship no license file are listed with their declared license and
repository only; check those by hand if a new one appears.
